title: Madeline passes
caption: She passed slowly through a remote portion of the gallery and disappeared, without having noticed my presence.

beat.means: a beat of the film (the beats module): the name — it plays from the start, at the end the scene says beat:<name>. Beats: pass, weep, follow, freeze, wake, look, gone, stay, doctor, beside, doctor_leaves, leave_with; moments — freeze:still, stay:talk

crack.means: the crack on the right pier of arch 2: 0 — none, 1 — run up to the vault and wide (the game sets it by the scale)

light_shafts.means: the windows' evening light (and its rays in the air): 0 — none, 1 — full

low_sun.means: 0 — evening, the windows' cold light; 1 — another day, a low warm sun (the physician)

sconce.means: the candle in the sconce on the left wall: 0 — out, 1 — burning

closeup.means: a close-up over the gallery (the closeups module): 0 — none, 1 — open

shot.means: whose close-up: Roderick (his face in his palms), Madeline (frozen — madeline_still), the physician

cu_turn.means: the face, close: the head's turn, + towards the window

cu_tear.means: the face, close: a tear — how far it has crept

cu_inhale.means: the face, close: a deep breath (0→1→0)

cu_blink.means: the face, close: blinking by hand (0 — blinks by itself, unless frozen)

speak.means: the lips in the close-up move: the game sets 1 while it says a line, then 0
